class_definition.scope_statement: The maximal globally hyperbolic development of generic asymptotically flat vacuum initial data (4-dimensional Einstein vacuum equations, Lambda = 0) has future null infinity I+ that is complete, and no future-incomplete causal geodesic is visible from I+. The class asserts hiddenness of singularities, not their absence.
class_definition.conclusion_statement: Generic asymptotically flat vacuum initial data have a maximal development with complete future null infinity and no singularity visible from future null infinity.
class_definition.conclusion_statement_formal: forall r in D0 exists G_r comeager forall D in G_r: AF_{I+}(M_D) and complete(I+_D) and not exists visible_singularity_from_I_plus(M_D)
forbidden_strengthenings: black-hole region non-empty (black-hole formation is a separate statement and is NOT part of this conclusion)
C2 or C0 inextendibility of the maximal development (SCC content)
the statement for ALL data rather than for generic data
class_definition.claim_promotion: epistemic_status=open_problem; recording conclusion_type=theorem requires artifact_refs with a checked proof and is auto-rejected otherwise
class_definition.quantifier_formal: forall r in D0: exists G_r subset X^r_vac(AF) with G_r comeager: forall (Sigma,h,K) in G_r, letting (M,g) be the maximal globally hyperbolic development: exists a conformal completion (Mtilde,gtilde,Omega) of (M,g) at I+ such that (i) I+ is null with I+ diffeomorphic to R x S^2, and (ii) every null geodesic generator of I+ is future-complete, and forall future-inextendible causal geodesics gamma of (M,g) with finite affine length: not exists q in I+ and t0 in [0,T) with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.

bindings.label: Christodoulou 2009: trapped-surface formation from short-pulse vacuum data
bindings.genericity: Open set within the short-pulse family (as restated by SRC-042: 'an open set of regular initial conditions'); NOT an open set of general asymptotically flat data.
scope_caveats: SRC-041 is the MG12 conference chapter (2012, pp. 24-34); the EMS Monograph is SRC-054 (arXiv:0805.3880) with DOI 10.4171/068 verified via Crossref.
Short-pulse data are special, not generic in the space of all AF data.
Trapped-surface formation is not by itself complete future null infinity (WCC), though it is the standard precursor.
